name: Honer AI
description: Honer AI by XONER is a proprietary Android 7.0+ assistant with Russian and English interfaces, streaming chat, web search with source links, photo/document attachments, voice input and conversation history. The current APK download is free. AI responses and search need internet access; relevant prompts and attachments use cloud processing. Optional phone actions require user-enabled Android Accessibility.
submitted_by: Codex AI assistant on behalf of publisher XONER (GitHub: XONER4)
